label: #3618230: Adopt the ajax MessageCommand for file uploads, pinned core
description: Upload a .txt file larger than 1 KB (for example 2 KB) in the Attachment field on a node form in both frames. Before: error message renders inside the file widget via standard insert AJAX command, bypassing theme message handling and aria live announcements. After (MR !16777): error messages are delivered via the dedicated AJAX MessageCommand into a placeholder wrapper.
status: draft: written from an issue pack; steps and checks have not been confirmed by a person

steps.text: The Article content type has an optional file field called Attachment, limited to 1 KB and .txt only.
Choose a .txt file larger than 1 KB (for example 2 KB) in the Attachment field in EACH frame. A file chooser cannot be mirrored, so do this by hand.
steps.lookFor: Before: error message renders inside the widget. After: message is delivered via MessageCommand targeting the file upload messages wrapper.

expected: Error messages during file upload are delivered via the AJAX MessageCommand instead of being baked into the replaced widget markup.
actual: Before, status messages are server-rendered inside the widget via insert command. After (MR !16777), MessageCommand is used.

checks.label: File upload input element is present on the node form
The file upload messages wrapper element exists

observe.label: Error message appears when uploading an oversized file
Error message uses the dedicated message container or AJAX MessageCommand structure
